summary_ja: ALCF LLM-Inference-Benchについて、8 accelerator class、5 serving framework、8 modelの公開code・dashboardを追加しました。framework非対称性、quality、tail latency、energy、cost、version不足から重要度は中とし、MLPerfの代替とは扱いません。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: For ALCF LLM-Inference-Bench, this update adds public code and a dashboard spanning eight accelerator classes, five serving frameworks, and eight models. Because of asymmetric framework coverage and gaps in quality, tail latency, energy, cost, and versioning, it is assigned medium priority and is not treated as a replacement for MLPerf. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.timing_en: 2024 arXiv v1; public repository checked September 2, 2026
items.statement_ja: ArgonneのLLM-Inference-Benchは、NVIDIA A100/H100/GH200、AMD MI250/MI300X、Intel Max1550、Habana Gaudi2、SambaNova SN40Lと、vLLM、llama.cpp、TensorRT-LLM、DeepSpeed-MII、SambaFlowの実行script・plot・dashboardを公開しています。LLaMA 2/3、Mistral/Mixtral、Qwen2の7B級と70B級を、batch sizeとinput/output length別に比較できます。異種acceleratorの初期screeningには有用ですが、全hardwareで同一frameworkが動くわけではなく、framework最適化差とhardware差が交絡します。
items.statement_en: Argonne's LLM-Inference-Bench publishes scripts, plots, and a dashboard covering NVIDIA A100, H100, and GH200; AMD MI250 and MI300X; Intel Max1550; Habana Gaudi2; and SambaNova SN40L with vLLM, llama.cpp, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed-MII, and SambaFlow. It compares 7B- and 70B-class LLaMA 2 and 3, Mistral and Mixtral, and Qwen2 models by batch size and input and output lengths. It is useful for initial cross-accelerator screening, but the same framework does not run on every platform, so framework optimization and hardware effects are confounded.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCI候補機の推論評価をNVIDIAだけに限定せず、同一model・precision・prompt形状で比較する出発点にできます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It can seed HPCI inference comparisons beyond NVIDIA under matched models, precision, and prompt shapes.
adoption_conditions_ja: 可能なplatformでは同一framework比較と各vendor最良framework比較を別々に示す。
single deviceとmulti-deviceを分け、topology、tensor/pipeline/expert parallel条件を保存する。
adoption_conditions_en: Pin model weights, tokenizers, precision, framework commits, drivers, compilers, kernels, batches, and lengths.
Where possible, report same-framework comparisons separately from each vendor's best framework.
Separate single- and multi-device results and preserve topology and tensor, pipeline, and expert parallel settings.

items.name_ja: 重要度「中」：再現可能codeはあるがservice品質・energyを要補完
items.name_en: Medium priority: reproducible code exists, but service quality and energy need coverage
items.statement_ja: repositoryとdashboardが公開され、複数hardwareで結果があるため、codeだけの小規模提案より優先度は高い一方、発表はarXiv v1です。公開概要はthroughput、batch、input/output lengthを中心とし、model品質、TTFT/ITLのp50/p95/p99、arrival process、request failure、cold start、energy、費用、license、長期回帰を共通条件で保証しません。したがってOpenFSでは重要度「中」の入力とし、MLPerf等を置換しません。
items.statement_en: Because the repository and dashboard are public and include results across multiple hardware classes, it has higher priority than a code-only small proposal, but the publication remains arXiv v1. Public material centers on throughput, batch size, and input and output length and does not guarantee matched model quality, p50/p95/p99 TTFT and ITL, arrival processes, request failures, cold starts, energy, cost, licensing, or longitudinal regression. OpenFS therefore treats it as a medium-priority input rather than a replacement for MLPerf or other controlled suites.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 継続測定ではこのmatrixへservice-level指標と科学task品質を足し、候補機変更後も同じcommitと結果schemaで追跡する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Continuous HPCI measurement should extend this matrix with service-level metrics and scientific-task quality and preserve commits and result schemas across candidate-system changes.
adoption_conditions_ja: task qualityまたは同一生成token条件を設け、速度だけでmodel変更を正当化しない。
quarterごとに固定anchorと現行versionの両方を測り、regressionと進歩を分離する。
adoption_conditions_en: Record throughput, TTFT and ITL distributions, failures, cold and warm states, energy, and cost in the same run.
Use task quality or matched generated-token conditions so model changes are not justified by speed alone.
Measure both a fixed anchor and current versions each quarter to separate regression from progress.
